{{Top}}
'''Micro-maneuvering controls''' were [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] maneuvering components. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles']] X-wing, [[Red Two|Red 2]], had its micro-maneuvering controls destroyed,<ref name="CCG-Red2">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Red 2}}</ref> forcing him to pull out of the attack run in the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Meridian trench/Legends|trench]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Antilles was forced to nurse his fighter back to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="CCG-Red2" />
